artifact: GRENDEL BC10 fermiophilic-ALP sensitivity (canonical published curve)
source_run: dense-grid campaign of 2026-07-12: 99-point mass grid (0.22-4.75 GeV; 0.02 GeV steps below 1 GeV, 0.05 to 3 GeV, 0.1 above), memory-bounded acceptance MC (EVENT_CHUNK=256, per-chunk seeds; see sensitivity.py) on the same physics inputs as the 2026-07-09 release

hypothesis.model: PBC BC10: pseudoscalar ALP with universal SM-fermion couplings
hypothesis.coupling: g_aff = c_f m_f / f with c_f = 1 (BNT arXiv:1708.00443 convention)
hypothesis.convention_note: 1/f here = 2/f_GKOZ (arXiv:2310.03524); map any GKOZ/PBC comparison curve accordingly

physics_inputs.production: b -> s a penguin as B -> K^(i) a summed over the kaon tower (K, K*, K0*, K1, K2*) per GKOZ arXiv:2310.03524; FONLL 14 TeV bottom kinematics (NNPDF4.0 NLO)
physics_inputs.decays: GKOZ data-driven spectral tables (leptons, photons, hadrons) via ALPINIST (arXiv:2201.05170), pinned in alp_fermion/data/alpinist/

analysis.reconstruction: shared GRENDEL 4-hit two-track vertex reco + PR #13 selection, imported from higgs/ and hnl/ (timing chi2 with daughter beta = p/E)

column_contract.invf_min: lower 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.invf_max: upper 1/f edge of the excluded island [GeV^-1]
column_contract.has_sensitivity: False => no excluded island at that mass (peak_N < 3)
column_contract.peak_N: signal yield at the optimal coupling (max over the 1/f scan)

closure_note: The island closes at m_a ~ 2.5 GeV, well below the B -> K a endpoint (m_B - m_K ~ 4.8 GeV): the growing hadronic width shortens the lifetime at fixed coupling faster than the coupling can be reduced while retaining N >= 3. The near-pinch at 1.6-1.8 GeV (peak_N ~ 3.2-3.5) is resolved on real grid points.
